'''Piko''' (Japanese: '''少年ピコ''' ''Young Piko'') is a minor recurring character who first appeared in ''[[SM073|Why Not Give Me a Z-Ring Sometime?]]''. In Japanese, he and {{al|Nene}} refer to [[Acerola]] as "Big Sis".

Piko is close friends with Nene. They asked [[Acerola]] to read them a story, which she did. They later watched as Acerola was captured by a {{p|Gengar}}.

Piko reappeared in ''[[SM074|Tough Guy Trials!]]'' at Acerola's house alongside Nene.
